newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daicel 96/97 profit seen less than forecast - paper.
newsitem.headline: Daicel 96/97 profit seen less than forecast - paper.

text.p: Daicel Chemical Industries Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of about eight billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997, 1.5 billion yen less than forecast, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the company would not be able to achieve its forecast due to sluggish sales and a rise in material costs.
Daicel posted a parent current profit of 6.09 billion yen in 1995/96.
The firm was not immediately available for comment.
